name: telugu-arc-c-2.5k
description: A 2.5k-item Telugu adaptation of ARC-style multiple-choice reasoning questions intended to evaluate models' grade-school science and commonsense reasoning in Telugu. Each item requires selecting the correct answer from multiple options, testing multilingual reasoning and domain knowledge in a low-resource language.
reputation: Part of the Indic-Benchmark suite and used within the Indic NLP community; moderate adoption for evaluating Telugu reasoning capabilities.
